gloss: cannot do anything about; by no means; at all

definitions.gloss: cannot do anything about; unable to handle; hopeless
definitions.explanation: indicates that something is beyond one's ability to control or manage, often used with negative expressions

examples.japanese: どうにも⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: There's nothing I can do about it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{眠|ねむ}くて→眠い：00872_nemui⟧どうにも⟦{我慢|がまん}できない→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm so sleepy I simply can't stand it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧どうにも⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{打|う}ち→打つ：01221_utsu⟧よう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's simply no way to deal with this situation.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically used with negative expressions:
- どうにも⟦ならない→なる：01970_naru⟧ - can't do anything about it
- どうにも～⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - simply cannot ~
- どうにも⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦つけられない→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ - can't handle it at all
Expresses helplessness or frustration at an uncontrollable situation. Stronger than simply saying ⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧.

CONTRAST WITH どうにか:
- ⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧ - positive outcome (somehow succeeded)
- どうにも - negative outcome (can't do anything about it)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {如何|いかん}ともしがたい - beyond one's power (formal)
- ⟦どうしようもない→どうしようもない：18862_doushiyoumonai⟧ - hopeless, can't be helped
- ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}し→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧よう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ - nothing can be done
